strings.forge_almanac.01_biomes.t1.actors.t1_act: A bristly pig that roots around the forest floor. It leaves you alone until you hit it — then it comes at you tusks first.
A watcher of stone and vine that guards the forest. It sees you coming and walks straight at you, swinging.
A watcher of stone and vine that guards the forest from a distance. It keeps its space and shoots.
A woodcutter who lives among the forest trees. Friendly, talks a lot, and always needs a hand carrying wood.
strings.forge_almanac.01_biomes.t1.ground.t1_gro: A wall of bare rock. You cannot walk through it — go around, or cut a way in with a pickaxe.
Water too deep to stand in. Build a bridge over it or walk around.
strings.forge_almanac.01_biomes.t1.items.t1_item: Black rock that burns hot and burns long. Without it a smelter melts nothing at all.
Coal
A spark of the magic that lives in the forest. Only the strongest recipes ask for it.
Forest Essence
Soft strands pulled from vine. Weave them into cloth at a smelter.
Vine Fiber
A flower of clover, picked whole. Pretty to look at, and plenty of recipes ask for one.
Clover
A bundle of grass, cut and tied. Animals come running for it.
Wild Hay
A leaf of green leaf, with healing folded inside it. Brew it into tea at a kitchen.
Green Leaf Herb
The raw hide of a boar, still stiff. Soften it at a smelter to get leather.
Boar Hide
Fresh palm logs, still smelling of sap. Cut them into planks at a smelter.
Palm Logs
Copper ore, dug straight out of the rock. Melt it at a smelter and it becomes a Copper Bar.
Copper Ore

A lash of living vine, thrown from a staff.

Damage: 1
Used with: Vine Staff
Vine Whip
A chunk of moss stone, hard and heavy. Building blocks are made from it.
Moss Stone

Two curved tusks a boar was born with.

Damage: 1
Energy per use: 1
Boar Tusks

Your own two hands. Nothing to make, nothing to break.

Damage: 0.25
Energy per use: 0.25
Bare Hands
strings.forge_almanac.01_biomes.t1.props.t1_prop: A crate someone nailed shut and left behind. Break it open and see.
Copper Box
A clover bush, tall and thick. Tall enough to crouch behind, too.
Clover Bush
A clover standing open in the light. Pick it with your hands.
Clover
A patch of green leaf growing low to the ground. Cut it with a sickle.
Green Leaf Herb
A vine plant growing wild. Cut it with a sickle for its fiber.
Vine Plant
A grown palm tree. Chop it with an axe and the logs fall.
Palm Tree
A tuft of tall forest grass. Animals graze on it when they are hurt or worn out.
Wild Grass
A boulder with coal seams running through it. Break it with a pickaxe — without coal a smelter melts nothing.
Coal Rock
A boulder with moss inside it. Break it with a pickaxe to carry the stone away.
Moss Rock
A vein of copper running through the stone. Break it with a pickaxe and the ore is yours.
Copper Vein
strings.forge_almanac.01_biomes.t2.items.t2_item: Fresh willow logs, still smelling of sap. Cut them into planks at a smelter.
strings.forge_almanac.02_workstations.01_smelter: The plain ground of wherever you are standing. Use it to fill a hole or flatten a patch.
strings.forge_almanac.03_farm.t1.t1_item_consuma:
A red apple picked straight off the tree, still cold from the shade.

When you use it:
- Health: +1
- Energy: +5

A handful of golden wheat. Grind it, bake it, and you have bread.

When you use it:
- Health: +1
- Energy: +5
strings.forge_almanac.03_farm.t1.t1_prop_crop_fr: A tree heavy with apple. Knock the fruit down with an axe — more grows back on its own.
strings.forge_almanac.03_farm.t1.t1_prop_crop_ve: Wheat growing in tilled soil. Water it, wait, then cut it with a sickle — and plant it again after.
strings.forge_almanac.03_farm.t1.t1_prop_soil.de: Ground turned over with a hoe and ready for seeds. Water it and things grow faster.
strings.forge_almanac.03_farm.t2.t2_item_consuma:
A dark plum from the swamp, so ripe it nearly falls on its own.

When you use it:
- Health: +1
- Energy: +5

A tomato from swamp soil, round and heavy in the hand.

When you use it:
- Health: +1
- Energy: +5
strings.forge_almanac.03_farm.t2.t2_prop_crop_fr: A tree heavy with plum. Knock the fruit down with an axe — more grows back on its own.
strings.forge_almanac.03_farm.t2.t2_prop_crop_ve: Tomato growing in tilled soil. Water it, wait, then cut it with a sickle — and plant it again after.
